Install OSR on your phone

Two minutes, once. If you have an older version on your phone, remove it first.

1

Remove the old app

Press and hold the old icon on your home screen.

Android: choose Uninstall (or drag it to Uninstall).

iPhone: choose Remove App, then Delete.

2

On Android

Open the link above in Chrome.

Tap the ⋮ menu (top right).

Tap Add to Home screen (or Install app), then Add.

3

On iPhone

Open the link above in Safari.

Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow).

Scroll down, tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.

That's it. Tap the new icon, open DOUBLES IPT, and you're set.

How OSR works: one system, your club in charge

DOUBLES IPT is part of a bigger system. Here is what that means, and what stays yours.

The whole system
OSR · Open Squash Ratings
Every province, club and division, and every player's one rating.
Your province
KZN
Its page shows every KZN club together.
Your club
DOUBLES IPT
Its own page, colour, code, members, ladders, court card and tournaments.
Its divisions
Div A to Div F
Set by rating; players move between them on their own.

One rating, everywhere. Every player, and every pair, has one OSR rating. It counts the same at every club and in every province, so a match played anywhere on OSR moves the same rating. Games are to 11.

Divisions run themselves. Div A is 1700 and up, Div B 1550 to 1700, Div C 1400 to 1550, Div D 1250 to 1400, Div E 1100 to 1250 and Div F below 1100. When you save a score, the players' ratings decide which division the match counts in.

Moving up and down. A player moves up a division at the line + 10 and down below the line − 10, so one result never bounces anyone back and forth.

Your club runs itself. DOUBLES IPT keeps its own page and colour, members, divisions, ladders, court card and tournaments, looked after by its own organisers in its own admin room, with its own code.

Part of something bigger. Your results also count across KZN and the whole system. Compare yourself with players everywhere under Ratings · Ladders · Profiles.

Where the app opens: the KZN page

The link opens on KZN, the front door for every club in the province. It works just like your club page below, one level up:

  • ‹ National goes up to the whole system.
  • Enter your match score and My page, as on every page.
  • Select your active clubs: switch clubs on or off and change their order (on your phone only).
  • One card per club: tap DOUBLES IPT to open your club.
  • KZN player and pairing stats: every KZN club together, with recent matches, form, movers and tournaments.

Tip: switch on Open the app here every time at the bottom of the DOUBLES IPT page and the app opens on your club instead.

Your owner's guide to the DOUBLES IPT page and everything behind it. The numbers on the pictures match the numbers in the text.

Your club page: top half

DOUBLES IPT. Your club's own front door: how many divisions, members and tournaments it has.

2

‹ KZN takes you up to the province page.

3

My page. Your own page: your rating, your division, your partners and every match.

4

Enter your match score. A page opens asking which division you played in, or which tournament. Fill in the players and the games (to 11), and save. The players' ratings decide the division the match counts in, and the ratings move straight away.

5

Select your active divisions. Choose which divisions show on this page: switch each on or off, change the order, or All on / All off. Remembered on your phone.

6

Division cards. One card per division, Div A to Div F, with its rating range and matches. Swipe sideways for the rest; tap Enter here to open a division.

7

Quick buttons. Form & Move, Ratings · Ladders · Profiles, Tournaments and Up. They stay at the top while you scroll.

8

Recent matches. The latest results, each tagged with its division and category; tap ▼ for the game scores.

9

The bottom bar, on every page: Club home, Enter a score and My page. The ← or ‹ back at the top left always takes you one step back.

Scroll down the club page

10

Recent ladder matches and Last match. Ladder matches are entered with Event: Ladder Match; beat the pair above you to take their place. Last match shows the latest result, the game scores and how long ago.

11

In form. The pairs on a run this week, with how many games they won. Ratings and ladders → opens the tables.

12

Movers this week. Who is climbing and who is giving ground, with their division. See player profiles here →.

13

Division moves. Who has moved up or down a division. A player moves up at the line + 10 and down below the line − 10.

14

Tournaments. Your club's tournaments; tap one for its draw, results and standings.

15

Everything else. My page; All tournaments (running and finished); Club admin (organisers only, with the club's code); About OSR (how the ratings work). Under it, the build number.
